_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Calibration Certificate/Report
summary: The Calibration Certificate/Report documents calibration certificates or reports accompanying calibrations performed on DoD test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment.
use_relationship:
The Calibration Certificate/Report documents calibration certificates or reports accompanying the calibrations performed on Department of Defense (DoD) test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is applicable to contracts requiring calibration of test equipment prior to delivery. This DID is consistent with ISO/IEC 17025, General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories, requirements for calibration reports or certificates.
(Copies of this document are available online at http://www.iso.org.)
c. This DID supersedes DI-QCIC-80798B.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The calibration certificate or report shall include:

children.title: Title (e.g., calibration certificate or calibration report);
The name and address of the laboratory and the location where the calibrations were carried out, if different from the address of the laboratory;

Unique identification of the calibration certificate or test report (such as the serial number), and on each page an identification in order to ensure that the page is recognized as a part of the test report or calibration certificate, and a clear identification of the end of the calibration certificate or test report;
The name and address of the client or customer;
A description of, the condition of, and the unambiguous identification of the item(s) tested or calibrated;
The date of receipt of the test or calibration item(s) where this is critical to the validity and application of the results, and the date(s) of performance of the test or calibration;
Reference to the sampling plan and procedures used by the laboratory or other bodies where these are relevant to the validity or application of the results;
The test or calibration results with, where appropriate, the units of measurement;
The name(s), function(s) and signature(s) or equivalent identification of person(s) authorizing the calibration certificate or test report;
Where relevant, a statement to the effect that the results relate only to the items tested or calibrated;
The conditions (e.g., environmental) under which the calibrations were made that have an influence on the measurement results;
The uncertainty of measurement or a statement of compliance with an identified metrological specification or clauses thereof;
Evidence that the measurements are traceable.
